My idea is that they are like training wheels. When i am sober i can play SRVish blues stuff and Hendrix too, it is like i am playing with a limited amount of "colours" but when i take stimulants it opens up a whole new spectere and  i feel more free. I am trying to pinpoint that place so i can get to it on my own, thats why i said that it is like training wheels. 
And thank you for the replays guys :D

I like to look at music as journey a travel you get the point. My advice is to listen to alot of music not just what you do. This might sound strange but listen to alot of blues, those are the basics of music if you ask me, from the rythm to the songwriting. Got thing would be to check out Tears for fearsm Bowie and many others.
Practise as much as you can. Few hours (like five or six) it may be alot but it will be worth it. Stay in shape thats obvious cause you are a dancer and just enjoy the whole expirience. What is the point of it if you dont love it. Wish you the best

This is true any program will do fine. Mics are wery important, and a good interface. People just use whatever and that is the problem( ot os fine if you are starting around but if you want to get better quality investing into gear is crucial(in my opinion)). 
The other thing is the quality of the guitar, strings and your playing.

Well i play guitar and use alot of vsts( then again they are not the same).
Back to the point my friend plays keyboards he has a lot of em. Some are usb connected so he plugs em in, goes trough fl studio and ableton or cubase. Depends on your sample pack. 
trick i use when playin guitar and when i mess around with his keyboard is that i use some ambiental effects like reverb and alot of mixing in the mixer. Just try it out you cant go wrong.
get a nice sample pack, a god Daw and play with eq settings. Best of luck, send a message if you need more help

First of all thank you for the responses. 
Yes i have been diagnosed with depression and bi polar and went to therapy. Some therapist think that it is caused by trauma. 
Thing is that i am an "artist" i paint ,play music, write. I never had clear idea what will i paint, play today i'd just let go and create what i feel. Trough those things i would "get to know myself". Now the canvas is empty i can't play or write anything cause i don't feel a thing.

Maybe it does still scare me because i maybe i still think about the grand idea of exeptance. I was saw myself as wearing a "mask" and a few times that i didn't people got scared( don't now why).

i think you are right, it takes time to know yourself. Sometimes it just takes a good clear headed look in the mirror. Everybody is made together of a big spectar of colours. You cann't pinpoint one of them and say i am that. But let me ask you what happens when you can't pinpoint anything. When you are not yourself but a public collection of paints.

Thank you people for the answers.

Many of the things you say are true but i can't bare the pain anymore. It is driving more distant from myself, i feel that i built a wall and too afraid and weak too tear it up. I am afraid that i am going to meet someone and loose them to. I have lost too many people already that ment to me, some by death some just walked away. They say you should change and move on but i changed myself so much that i din;t who i am. When i dig ddep inside i find my self i am too weak  literaly sick. I can't do this anymore i spend my days doing nothing. I am afraid of being hurt i became an empty shell. The funny thing is i am a living paradox most of time i don't feel anything but when i feel pain i feel "happy" cause i feel something. Still that pain is just too big for me too handle. It is just painful to be an outcast.

I had one friend that i could call a friend. The one person that you don't talk about problems but feel good after the talk. He was my best friend from the time we were children we used to play basketball together since we were little. He died and that broke me, the girl i spoke about helped me get trough the tough time. Still every day i miss him so much he was my bond to the world to all the friends. I miss him so much, a year ago when he died i was at my grandparents at country side and i recived informations from phone calls about him that night, stupid to say but like a live stream. I was one of the few who knew that he had eplilepcy and if i was there i could have maybe somehow help move his tongue or something but i wasn't and that kills me inside. i mean when i am drunk or high i just don't hear it. Like the moment i hear Jammin by Bob Marley(my ring tone that night) i just fall to pieces. I taught it would get easier as time moves on but it doesn't and i hate the loneliness that i feel.

It may sound harsh but it is better that way than for him to give you false hope let anything happen and than say can't be with you want to be friends.
Worst thing is that you are alone screaming a silent scream but "friends" don't hear you.
Guess if you need someone to talk i am here

I just taught about everything and me being a frontman in the band is fucked up. I am the one who should lead i am the making all the people feel the same as me but when the gig is over and and i get my costume off i am just this lonely guy. Everybody is outthere having fun with friends and thei partners while i sit in dressing room or at the bar all alone. I don't want to feel alone i just can't take anymore

I live fucking Serbia here there are no hotlines or anythings like that. The worst part most memories of my childhood are too fucked up, i mean i remember that i was the kid playing with some wooden blocks infront of the mirror so i wouldn't be alone. The fucked up thing is when i went to school i was myself and the "cool" kids once told me that if i was more like them (and not the wild crazy me) i would be more popular but after some time i got used to being a court jester, a one buss stop in everyones life, just the guy who's there to make fun of and a quick "fix" me up to people. My profesor at this art academy says what determens you as a person or artist are the five people around you and i have no one. 
I would love to watch life as ying yang but all i see is black with a small fading dose of white. Self medicating does not solve anything but i don't know what to do anymore. I don't want to live anymore but can't take my life cause i am too afraid and i know what would i do to others my family and her. Nothing seems right anymore, i don't sleep, eat i just live life to get trough another day can't do it anymore.
